--!strict
-- Starfall Rotlings: tuning and world constants.
-- One place for every number the game balances on, so a balance pass
-- touches this file and nothing else. Rarities live in RarityConfig,
-- mutations in MutationConfig, shop ladders in ShopService, storm timing
-- in StarfallService and rebirth pricing in RebirthService.

local Config = {}

-- World layout (studs). The crater sits at the origin; bases ring it.
Config.BASE_COUNT = 8
Config.BASE_RADIUS = 110
Config.PADS_PER_BASE = 8 -- 6 open, 2 unlocked by the shop
Config.PADS_OPEN = 6 -- pads a fresh base starts with
Config.CRATER_RADIUS = 28
Config.CRATER_FLOOR_Y = 0.4 -- top of the crater disc: Rotlings spawn and meteors land here
Config.GROUND_SIZE = 480

-- Spawning.
Config.SPAWN_INTERVAL = 4 -- seconds between spawn attempts
Config.CRATER_MAX_FREE = 10 -- free Rotlings at once in the crater
Config.CRATER_MIN_FREE = 6 -- the conveyor never drops below this: top up fast
Config.CRATER_INITIAL = 8 -- Rotlings waiting when the first player arrives

-- Missions: a short rotating list, one at a time. Progress is counted
-- on the server (grabs, places, coins earned); finishing one pays the
-- reward and moves to the next.
Config.MISSIONS = {
	{ id = "grab", text = "Grab 3 Rotlings", target = 3, reward = 300 },
	{ id = "place", text = "Place 3 Rotlings on your base", target = 3, reward = 500 },
	{ id = "earn", text = "Earn $5,000 coins", target = 5000, reward = 750 },
}

-- Daily reward: claimable once per cooldown from the HUD Daily button.
Config.DAILY_REWARD = 1000
Config.DAILY_COOLDOWN = 20 * 3600 -- 20 hours between claims

-- Selling: carry a Rotling to the gold SELL pad by spawn and press E.
-- A Rotling sells for one minute of its own income (baseCps x 60).
Config.SELL_MULT = 60

-- Meteor storm: a full cycle is calm + warning + storm.
Config.STORM_PERIOD = 90
Config.STORM_WARN = 10 -- warning seconds before the meteors fall
Config.STORM_DURATION = 8
Config.STORM_METEOR_INTERVAL = 0.45
Config.STORM_DAMAGE = 15 -- health lost per meteor hit while in the crater
Config.STARSTRUCK_CHANCE = 0.4 -- a free Rotling near an impact survives as Starstruck

-- Bases and stealing.
Config.LOCK_DURATION = 60 -- seconds a base lock holds
Config.LOCK_COOLDOWN = 90 -- seconds before the lock can be used again
Config.LOCK_DURATION_PER_TIER = 30 -- +30s lock per shop lock tier
-- Carrying: the Rotling rides IN FRONT OF THE CHEST at arm height,
-- never above the head and never over the face. Forward is -Z off the
-- HumanoidRootPart, so a negative Z puts it in front of the player.
Config.CARRY_Y = -0.3 -- studs below the root centre: chest/arm height
Config.CARRY_Z = -2.2 -- studs in front of the chest
-- Carried size: the real model at a readable scale, never a tiny box.
Config.CARRY_MAX_HEIGHT = 3.0 -- a carried Rotling is at most 3 studs tall
Config.PLACE_RANGE = 14 -- how close to a free pad the carrier must stand

-- Name tags: only the nearest few, only up close, so they never stack
-- into unreadable text when Rotlings stand close together.
Config.TAG_MAX_DISTANCE = 25 -- a tag only shows within 25 studs
Config.TAG_MAX_SHOWN = 3 -- at most the 3 nearest tags at once
Config.CRATER_MIN_SPACING = 6 -- crater Rotlings at least 6 studs apart

-- Economy.
Config.TICK_INTERVAL = 1 -- coins are paid out once a second
Config.REBIRTH_BASE_COST = 10000
Config.REBIRTH_MULT_PER = 0.25 -- +25% income per rebirth
Config.INCOME_TIER_MULT = 0.25 -- +25% income per shop income tier
Config.SPEED_PER_TIER = 2 -- +2 WalkSpeed per shop speed tier
Config.BASE_WALKSPEED = 16

-- Rot Raiders: NPC thieves that raid bases on a timer.
Config.RAIDER_FIRST = 45 -- seconds after server start before the first raid
Config.RAIDER_INTERVAL = 75 -- seconds between raids
Config.RAIDER_LIFETIME = 90 -- seconds before a raider gives up and leaves
Config.RAIDER_WALK_SPEED = 14

-- Saving.
Config.SAVE_INTERVAL = 60 -- seconds between autosaves
Config.DATASTORE_NAME = "StarfallRotlings_PlayerData"
Config.SAVE_VERSION = 3 -- v3 adds missionIndex/missionProgress/lastDailyClaim

--!strict
-- Starfall Rotlings: number and time formatting for the HUD.
-- One place for the K/M/B coin counters, the per-second lines and the
-- countdown clocks, so every label on screen reads the same way.

local Formatting = {}

-- Short money: 999 -> "$999", 1,250 -> "$1.25K", 2,400,000 -> "$2.40M".
function Formatting.formatMoney(n: number): string
	local value = math.floor(n)
	if value < 1000 then
		return "$" .. tostring(value)
	elseif value < 1_000_000 then
		return string.format("$%.2fK", value / 1000)
	elseif value < 1_000_000_000 then
		return string.format("$%.2fM", value / 1_000_000)
	else
		return string.format("$%.2fB", value / 1_000_000_000)
	end
end

-- Long money with commas: 1,250,000 -> "$1,250,000".
function Formatting.formatMoneyLong(n: number): string
	local s = tostring(math.floor(n))
	local out = ""
	while #s > 3 do
		out = "," .. string.sub(s, -3) .. out
		s = string.sub(s, 1, -4)
	end
	return "$" .. s .. out
end

-- Income line: "+$1.2K/s" for the HUD, "$300/s" for small labels.
function Formatting.formatCps(n: number): string
	return "+" .. Formatting.formatMoney(n) .. "/s"
end

-- Countdown: 75 -> "1:15", 8 -> "0:08".
function Formatting.formatClock(seconds: number): string
	local total = math.max(0, math.floor(seconds))
	local minutes = math.floor(total / 60)
	local secs = total % 60
	return string.format("%d:%02d", minutes, secs)
end

return Formatting

--!strict
-- Starfall Rotlings: mutations.
-- A spawn-time roll that multiplies a Rotling's income and repaints it.
-- Starstruck is never rolled: a Rotling only earns it by surviving a
-- meteor hit during a storm (see StarfallService).

export type Mutation = {
	name: string,
	mult: number,
	chance: number, -- per-spawn roll chance; 0 means never rolled
	color: Color3,
	glow: Color3, -- PointLight colour on the creature
}

local MutationConfig = {}

MutationConfig.MUTATIONS = {
	{ name = "Gold", mult = 2, chance = 0.08, color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 215, 0), glow = Color3.fromRGB(255, 210, 60) },
	{ name = "Frozen", mult = 3, chance = 0.05, color = Color3.fromRGB(150, 220, 255), glow = Color3.fromRGB(120, 200, 255) },
	{ name = "Rainbow", mult = 5, chance = 0.02, color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 120, 220), glow = Color3.fromRGB(255, 100, 220) },
	{ name = "Starstruck", mult = 4, chance = 0, color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 240, 170), glow = Color3.fromRGB(255, 245, 200) },
} :: { Mutation }

function MutationConfig.mutationByName(name: string?): Mutation?
	if name == nil then
		return nil
	end
	for _, mutation in ipairs(MutationConfig.MUTATIONS) do
		if mutation.name == name then
			return mutation
		end
	end
	return nil
end

-- Roll one mutation at spawn. Most spawns come back plain.
function MutationConfig.rollMutation(): string?
	local roll = math.random()
	local running = 0
	for _, mutation in ipairs(MutationConfig.MUTATIONS) do
		running += mutation.chance
		if roll <= running then
			return mutation.name
		end
	end
	return nil
end

-- Income multiplier for a mutation name, 1 when there is none.
function MutationConfig.mutationMult(name: string?): number
	local mutation = MutationConfig.mutationByName(name)
	if mutation then
		return mutation.mult
	end
	return 1
end

return MutationConfig

--!strict
-- Starfall Rotlings: the rarity ladder.
-- Six tiers, each with its own glow colour, spawn weight and base
-- coins-per-second. The ladder is the game's spine: every spawn roll,
-- every label and every income number reads it.

export type Rarity = {
	name: string,
	color: Color3,
	weight: number,
	cps: number,
}

local RarityConfig = {}

RarityConfig.RARITIES = {
	{ name = "Common", color = Color3.fromRGB(110, 200, 255), weight = 45, cps = 1 },
	{ name = "Rare", color = Color3.fromRGB(80, 220, 100), weight = 28, cps = 4 },
	{ name = "Epic", color = Color3.fromRGB(180, 90, 255), weight = 15, cps = 12 },
	{ name = "Legendary", color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 200, 40), weight = 8, cps = 35 },
	{ name = "Mythic", color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 80, 140), weight = 3, cps = 100 },
	{ name = "Cosmic", color = Color3.fromRGB(60, 220, 255), weight = 1, cps = 300 },
} :: { Rarity }

RarityConfig.ORDER = { "Common", "Rare", "Epic", "Legendary", "Mythic", "Cosmic" }

function RarityConfig.rarityByName(name: string): Rarity
	for _, rarity in ipairs(RarityConfig.RARITIES) do
		if rarity.name == name then
			return rarity
		end
	end
	return RarityConfig.RARITIES[1]
end

-- Weighted roll: Commons flood the crater, Cosmics almost never fall.
function RarityConfig.rollRarity(): string
	local total = 0
	for _, rarity in ipairs(RarityConfig.RARITIES) do
		total += rarity.weight
	end
	local roll = math.random(1, total)
	local running = 0
	for _, rarity in ipairs(RarityConfig.RARITIES) do
		running += rarity.weight
		if roll <= running then
			return rarity.name
		end
	end
	return "Common"
end

-- 1-based ladder step, for banners and the Index ("Tier 4 of 6").
function RarityConfig.rarityTier(name: string): number
	for i, rarity in ipairs(RarityConfig.RARITIES) do
		if rarity.name == name then
			return i
		end
	end
	return 1
end

return RarityConfig

--!strict
-- Starfall Rotlings: bases, pads and locks.
-- A base is a home platform with eight pads (six open, two unlocked by
-- the shop). A lock button bars stealing for 60 seconds, longer with the
-- shop's lock tiers. Every rule is checked on the server. Placing and
-- carrying live in CarryService; stealing lives in StealService.

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local Config = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Config)
local Remotes = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Remotes)
local State = require(script.Parent.State)
local WorldBuilder = require(script.Parent.WorldBuilder)

local BaseService = {}

-- -- Base assignment -------------------------------------------------------

function BaseService.assignBase(player: Player): number?
	for baseId = 1, Config.BASE_COUNT do
		if State.baseOwner[baseId] == nil then
			State.baseOwner[baseId] = player.UserId
			State.playerBase[player.UserId] = baseId
			State.placed[baseId] = {}
			State.locks[baseId] = { lockedUntil = 0, cooldownUntil = 0 }
			local DataService = require(script.Parent.DataService)
			local profile = DataService.getProfile(player)
			State.unlockedPads[baseId] = Config.PADS_OPEN + (if profile then profile.padsTier else 0)
			WorldBuilder.setBaseSign(baseId, player.DisplayName .. "'s Base")
			WorldBuilder.setBaseCoins(baseId, if profile then profile.coins else 0)
			if profile and profile.rebirths > 0 then
				local RebirthService = require(script.Parent.RebirthService)
				local color = RebirthService.COLORS[(profile.rebirths - 1) % #RebirthService.COLORS + 1]
				WorldBuilder.setBaseColor(baseId, color)
			end
			return baseId
		end
	end
	return nil
end

function BaseService.freeBase(player: Player)
	local baseId = State.playerBase[player.UserId]
	if not baseId then
		return
	end
	-- Rotlings left on the pads wander back to the crater, free to catch.
	local CarryService = require(script.Parent.CarryService)
	for _, model in pairs(State.placed[baseId] or {}) do
		CarryService.scatterToCrater(model)
	end
	State.placed[baseId] = nil
	State.baseOwner[baseId] = nil
	State.playerBase[player.UserId] = nil
	State.locks[baseId] = nil
	State.unlockedPads[baseId] = nil
	State.baseColors[baseId] = nil
	WorldBuilder.setBaseSign(baseId, "Base " .. tostring(baseId))
	WorldBuilder.setBaseCoins(baseId, 0)
end

function BaseService.getPlayerBase(userId: number): number?
	return State.playerBase[userId]
end

function BaseService.getBaseOwner(baseId: number): number?
	return State.baseOwner[baseId]
end

-- -- Locks ------------------------------------------------------------------

function BaseService.lockDurationFor(player: Player): number
	local DataService = require(script.Parent.DataService)
	local profile = DataService.getProfile(player)
	local tier = if profile then profile.lockTier else 0
	return Config.LOCK_DURATION + Config.LOCK_DURATION_PER_TIER * tier
end

function BaseService.isLocked(baseId: number): boolean
	local lock = State.locks[baseId]
	if not lock then
		return false
	end
	return time() < lock.lockedUntil
end

function BaseService.lockRemaining(baseId: number): number
	local lock = State.locks[baseId]
	if not lock then
		return 0
	end
	return math.max(0, lock.lockedUntil - time())
end

function BaseService.lockCooldownRemaining(baseId: number): number
	local lock = State.locks[baseId]
	if not lock then
		return 0
	end
	return math.max(0, lock.cooldownUntil - time())
end

-- Turn a player's base lock on. Returns (ok, message).
function BaseService.lockBase(player: Player): (boolean, string)
	local baseId = State.playerBase[player.UserId]
	if not baseId then
		return false, "You have no base yet."
	end
	if BaseService.isLocked(baseId) then
		return false, "Your base is already locked."
	end
	local cooldown = BaseService.lockCooldownRemaining(baseId)
	if cooldown > 0 then
		return false, "Lock recharges in " .. tostring(math.ceil(cooldown)) .. "s."
	end
	local duration = BaseService.lockDurationFor(player)
	local now = time()
	State.locks[baseId].lockedUntil = now + duration

-- One DataStore, one key per player, versioned records, autosave + leave

local store: DataStore? = nil

local function getStore(): DataStore?
	if store ~= nil then
		return store
	end
	local ok, result = pcall(function()
		return DataStoreService:GetDataStore(Config.DATASTORE_NAME)
	end)
	if ok then
		store = result
	end
	return store
end

function DataService.defaultProfile(): State.Profile
	return {
		version = Config.SAVE_VERSION,
		coins = 0,
		rebirths = 0,
		speedTier = 0,
		carryTier = 0,
		incomeTier = 0,
		padsTier = 0,
		lockTier = 0,
		index = {},
		indexRewards = {},
		indexFullRewarded = false,
		placed = {},
		missionIndex = 1,
		missionProgress = 0,
		lastDailyClaim = 0,
	}
end

local function reconcile(data: any): State.Profile
	local profile = DataService.defaultProfile()
	if typeof(data) ~= "table" then
		return profile
	end
	for key, value in pairs(data) do
		(profile :: any)[key] = value
	end
	profile.version = Config.SAVE_VERSION
	if typeof(profile.index) ~= "table" then
		profile.index = {}
	end
	if typeof(profile.indexRewards) ~= "table" then
		profile.indexRewards = {}
	end
	if typeof(profile.placed) ~= "table" then
		profile.placed = {}
	end
	if profile.padsTier == nil then
		profile.padsTier = 0
	end
	if profile.lockTier == nil then
		profile.lockTier = 0
	end
	return profile
end

-- Load a player's record (3 tries), falling back to a fresh profile.
function DataService.loadProfile(player: Player): State.Profile
	local profile = DataService.defaultProfile()
	local ds = getStore()
	if ds then
		for _ = 1, 3 do
			local ok, data = pcall(function()
				return ds:GetAsync("User_" .. tostring(player.UserId))
			end)
			if ok then
				if data ~= nil then
					profile = reconcile(data)
				end
				State.datastoreOk[player.UserId] = true
				break
			end
			task.wait(1)
		end
	end
	State.profiles[player.UserId] = profile
	return profile
end

-- Save a player's record now. Returns false when there is no store.
function DataService.saveProfile(player: Player): boolean
	local profile = State.profiles[player.UserId]
	if not profile then
		return false
	end
	local BaseService = require(script.Parent.BaseService)
	profile.placed = BaseService.snapshotPlaced(player)
	local ds = getStore()
	if not ds then
		return false
	end
	local ok = pcall(function()
		ds:SetAsync("User_" .. tostring(player.UserId), profile)
	end)
	if ok then
		State.datastoreOk[player.UserId] = true
	end
	return ok
end

-- One place for the feel of every action: a sound, a particle burst

	sound.SoundId = PING_SOUND

	elseif target:IsA("Model") then

		if primary and primary:IsA("BasePart") then
			part = primary
		end
	end
	if not part then

	emitter.Name = "FeedbackBurst"
	emitter.Color = ColorSequence.new(color or Color3.fromRGB(255, 225, 90))
	emitter.Size = NumberSequence.new({ NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0.6), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 0) })

--!strict
-- Starfall Rotlings: coins per second and the HUD feed.
-- The server owns every number. Once a second it pays every placed
-- Rotling's income, floats one "+$N" above a random earner, and sends
-- every player their HUD numbers. The client only ever shows what this
-- module sends.

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")

local Config = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Config)
local Formatting = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Formatting)
local Remotes = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Remotes)
local RotlingCatalog = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.RotlingCatalog)
local BaseService = require(script.Parent.BaseService)
local CarryService = require(script.Parent.CarryService)
local DailyService = require(script.Parent.DailyService)
local DataService = require(script.Parent.DataService)
local MissionService = require(script.Parent.MissionService)
local StarfallService = require(script.Parent.StarfallService)
local State = require(script.Parent.State)
local WorldBuilder = require(script.Parent.WorldBuilder)

local IncomeService = {}

-- Player income multiplier: rebirths and shop income tiers stack.
function IncomeService.incomeMult(player: Player): number
	local profile = DataService.getProfile(player)
	if not profile then
		return 1
	end
	return (1 + Config.REBIRTH_MULT_PER * profile.rebirths)
		* (1 + Config.INCOME_TIER_MULT * profile.incomeTier)
end

-- Coins per second from one player's placed Rotlings, after multipliers.
function IncomeService.coinsPerSecond(player: Player): number
	local total = 0
	for _, model in ipairs(BaseService.getPlacedForPlayer(player)) do
		local def = RotlingCatalog.getDef(model:GetAttribute("DefId") :: string)
		if def then
			total += RotlingCatalog.baseCps(def, model:GetAttribute("Mutation") :: string?)
		end
	end
	return math.floor(total * IncomeService.incomeMult(player))
end

-- Send every player their current HUD numbers.
-- Each player's send is protected: one bad profile or a dropped
-- connection must never take the whole feed down with it.
function IncomeService.broadcastHud()
	local storm = StarfallService.getStatus()
	for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
		local ok, err = pcall(function()
			local profile = DataService.getProfile(player)
			if profile then
				local baseId = BaseService.getPlayerBase(player.UserId)
				-- The floating cash counter above the owner's base.
				if baseId then
					WorldBuilder.setBaseCoins(baseId, profile.coins)
					-- The base level sign: 1 + Rotlings placed here.
					WorldBuilder.setBaseLevel(baseId, 1 + #BaseService.getPlacedForPlayer(player))
				end
				local found = 0
				for _ in pairs(profile.index) do
					found += 1
				end
				local mission = MissionService.currentMission(player)
				Remotes.hudEvent():FireClient(player, {
					coins = profile.coins,
					cps = IncomeService.coinsPerSecond(player),
					rebirths = profile.rebirths,
					speedTier = profile.speedTier,
					carryTier = profile.carryTier,
					incomeTier = profile.incomeTier,
					padsTier = profile.padsTier,
					lockTier = profile.lockTier,
					carried = #CarryService.getCarried(player),
					carrySlots = CarryService.getCarrySlots(player),
					lockRemaining = if baseId then BaseService.lockRemaining(baseId) else 0,
					lockCooldown = if baseId then BaseService.lockCooldownRemaining(baseId) else 0,
					stormPhase = storm.phase,
					stormSeconds = storm.secondsLeft,
					index = profile.index,
					firstTime = profile.coins == 0 and profile.rebirths == 0 and found == 0,
					missionText = mission.text,
					missionProgress = MissionService.progress(player),
					missionTarget = mission.target,
					missionReward = mission.reward,
					dailyReady = DailyService.isReady(player),
				})
			end
		end)
		if not ok then
			warn("Starfall broadcastHud failed for " .. player.Name .. ": " .. tostring(err))
		end
	end
end

-- Float one "+$N" above a random placed Rotling, rising and fading.
local function floatIncomeNumber()
	local allPlaced: { Model } = {}
	for _, byPad in pairs(State.placed) do
		for _, model in pairs(byPad) do
			table.insert(allPlaced, model)
		end
	end
	if #allPlaced == 0 then
		return
	end
	local model = allPlaced[math.random(1, #allPlaced)]
	local body = model.PrimaryPart
	if not body then
		return
	end
	local def = RotlingCatalog.getDef(model:GetAttribute("DefId") :: string)
	if not def then
		return
	end
	local ownerId = model:GetAttribute("OwnerUserId") :: number
	local owner = Players:GetPlayerByUserId(ownerId)
	local amount = 0
	if owner then
		amount = math.floor(RotlingCatalog.baseCps(def, model:GetAttribute("Mutation") :: string?) * IncomeService.incomeMult(owner))
	end
	if amount <= 0 then
		return
	end
	local billboard = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
	billboard.Name = "IncomeFloat"
	billboard.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(120, 36)
	billboard.StudsOffsetWorldSpace = Vector3.new(0, def.size + 1, 0)
	billboard.AlwaysOnTop = true
	billboard.LightInfluence = 0
	billboard.Parent = body
	local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	label.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
	label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	label.Text = "+" .. Formatting.formatMoney(amount)
	label.Font = Enum.Font.FredokaOne
	label.TextScaled = true
	label.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 230, 90)
	label.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.3
	label.Parent = billboard
	local tween = TweenService:Create(billboard, TweenInfo.new(1.2, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
		StudsOffsetWorldSpace = Vector3.new(0, def.size + 4, 0),
	})
	tween:Play()
	local fade = TweenService:Create(label, TweenInfo.new(1.2, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
		TextTransparency = 1,
		TextStrokeTransparency = 1,
	})
	fade:Play()
	task.delay(1.3, function()
		billboard:Destroy()
	end)
end

-- Start the coin tick and the autosave loop.
-- The tick is wrapped so one bad player or value can never kill the
-- loop: a dead loop means the HUD (and the storm timer) freeze for
-- everyone, with nothing in the Output to explain it.
function IncomeService.start()
	local tickCount = 0
	task.spawn(function()
		while true do
			task.wait(Config.TICK_INTERVAL)
			tickCount += 1
			local ok, err = pcall(function()
				for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
					local profile = DataService.getProfile(player)
					if profile then
						local gained = IncomeService.coinsPerSecond(player)
						profile.coins += gained
						MissionService.addProgress(player, "earn", gained)
						local LeaderstatsService = require(script.Parent.LeaderstatsService)
						LeaderstatsService.refresh(player)
					end
				end
				floatIncomeNumber()
				IncomeService.broadcastHud()
			end)
			if not ok then
				warn("Starfall income tick failed: " .. tostring(err))
			end
			-- Storm heartbeat (every 5 ticks): proves the loop is alive
			-- and shows the phase + seconds the HUD should be displaying.
			-- Also the storm watchdog: if the phase machine ever stalls,
			-- ensureRunning restarts it, so a dead storm thread can
			-- never leave the countdown ticking to zero with no storm.
			if tickCount % 5 == 0 then
				local status = StarfallService.getStatus()
				local playerCount = #Players:GetPlayers()
				print("[Starfall] tick " .. tostring(tickCount) .. ": storm phase=" .. tostring(status.phase) .. " secondsLeft=" .. tostring(math.ceil(status.secondsLeft)) .. " players=" .. tostring(playerCount))
				StarfallService.ensureRunning()
			end
		end
	end)

	-- Autosave, staggered by join order so servers do not spike together.
	task.spawn(function()
		while true do
			task.wait(Config.SAVE_INTERVAL)
			for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
				DataService.saveProfile(player)
				task.wait(1)
			end
		end
	end)
end

return IncomeService

--!strict
-- Starfall Rotlings: the Index.
-- Every Rotling a player has grabbed or placed is logged here. Cards stay
-- greyed out until found. Completing one rarity's set pays coins; finding
-- all twelve pays a big reward once.

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local Config = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Config)
local Formatting = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Formatting)
local Remotes = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Remotes)
local RotlingCatalog = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.RotlingCatalog)
local DataService = require(script.Parent.DataService)

local IndexService = {}

-- Log a Rotling as found, and pay any completion reward it triggers.
function IndexService.markFound(player: Player, defId: string)
	local profile = DataService.getProfile(player)
	if not profile then
		return
	end
	local firstTime = profile.index[defId] == nil
	profile.index[defId] = true
	if not firstTime then
		return
	end
	local def = RotlingCatalog.getDef(defId)
	if not def then
		return
	end
	-- Whole rarity set found? Pay once per rarity.
	local setComplete = true
	for _, other in ipairs(RotlingCatalog.defsOfRarity(def.rarity)) do
		if profile.index[other.id] == nil then
			setComplete = false
			break
		end
	end
	if setComplete and profile.indexRewards[def.rarity] == nil then
		profile.indexRewards[def.rarity] = true
		profile.coins += Config.INDEX_RARITY_REWARD
		Remotes.bannerEvent():FireClient(player, "Index: every " .. def.rarity .. " found! +" .. Formatting.formatMoney(Config.INDEX_RARITY_REWARD) .. "!", 4)
	end
	-- All twelve found? Pay the big reward once.
	if not profile.indexFullRewarded then
		local found = 0
		for _ in pairs(profile.index) do
			found += 1
		end
		if found >= #RotlingCatalog.DEFS then
			profile.indexFullRewarded = true
			profile.coins += Config.INDEX_FULL_REWARD
			Remotes.bannerEvent():FireClient(player, "INDEX COMPLETE! All 12 Rotlings found! +" .. Formatting.formatMoney(Config.INDEX_FULL_REWARD) .. "!", 6)
		end
	end
end

-- How many Rotlings this player has found, of the twelve.
function IndexService.foundCount(player: Player): number
	local profile = DataService.getProfile(player)
	if not profile then
		return 0
	end
	local found = 0
	for _ in pairs(profile.index) do
		found += 1
	end
	return found
end

-- Starfall Rotlings: server bootstrap.
-- Builds the world, starts every service, wires the remotes, and handles
-- players joining, dying and leaving. One system per module; the server
-- owns every number and the client only ever asks.
--
-- NOTE: this file is Main.server.luau, NOT init.server.luau, on purpose.
-- A folder with an init.server.luau collapses into the Script itself in
-- Rojo, so script.Parent inside it is ServerScriptService and every
-- require(script.Parent.X) fails — the whole server died on line 9 and
-- nothing (no map, no bases, no storm) ever ran. As a plain Script in the
-- Server folder, script.Parent is the folder and the requires resolve.

local Players = game:GetService("Players")

-- Run one startup step, warning (not dying) when it fails, so Studio's
-- Output shows exactly where the boot stops. Returns false on failure.
local function step(name: string, fn: () -> ()): boolean
	local ok, err = pcall(fn)
	if not ok then
		warn("[Server] step failed: " .. name .. " — " .. tostring(err))
	end
	return ok
end

local BaseService = require(script.Parent.BaseService)
local CarryService = require(script.Parent.CarryService)
local DailyService = require(script.Parent.DailyService)
local DataService = require(script.Parent.DataService)
local IncomeService = require(script.Parent.IncomeService)
local LeaderstatsService = require(script.Parent.LeaderstatsService)
local RaiderService = require(script.Parent.RaiderService)
local RebirthService = require(script.Parent.RebirthService)
local SellService = require(script.Parent.SellService)
local ShopService = require(script.Parent.ShopService)
local SpawnService = require(script.Parent.SpawnService)
local StarfallService = require(script.Parent.StarfallService)
local State = require(script.Parent.State)
local WorldBuilder = require(script.Parent.WorldBuilder)

-- Build first, then start the services that depend on the world.
-- The map is critical: without it nothing else can run, so a failed map
-- aborts the boot. Every other step warns and continues.
if not step("map (WorldBuilder.build)", WorldBuilder.build) then
	warn("[Server] boot aborted: map failed to build.")
	return
end
step("bases (BaseService.init)", BaseService.init)
step("carry (CarryService.init)", CarryService.init)
step("shop (ShopService.init)", ShopService.init)
step("sell (SellService.init)", SellService.init)
step("daily (DailyService.init)", DailyService.init)
step("rebirth (RebirthService.init)", RebirthService.init)
step("income (IncomeService.start)", IncomeService.start)
step("storm (StarfallService.start)", StarfallService.start)
step("spawner (SpawnService.start)", SpawnService.start)
step("raiders (RaiderService.start)", RaiderService.start)

-- Pad prompts: pressing E on any pad asks the server to place the
-- Rotling you carry (it checks the pad is yours and free).
for _, descendant in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
	if descendant:IsA("ProximityPrompt") and descendant.Parent and descendant.Parent.Name == "Pad" then
		descendant.Triggered:Connect(function(player: Player)
			CarryService.tryPlace(player)
		end)
	end
end

local function onCharacterAdded(player: Player, character: Model)
	ShopService.applyWalkSpeed(player)
	-- Spawn at your own base, facing the crater: stand beside the
	-- platform's front corner, so the glowing pads are right beside you
	-- and the crater is straight ahead. (The SpawnLocation alone can't
	-- do this: it is one fixed spot, and your base depends on join order.)
	local baseId = BaseService.getPlayerBase(player.UserId)
	local baseCf = if baseId then WorldBuilder.baseCFrame(baseId) else nil
	if baseCf then
		local side = baseCf * CFrame.new(18, 0, -4)
		local spawnPos = Vector3.new(side.Position.X, 3, side.Position.Z)
		local spawnCf = CFrame.lookAt(spawnPos, Vector3.new(0, 3, 0))
		local root = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		if not root then
			root = character:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart", 5)
		end
		if root then
			character:PivotTo(spawnCf)
		end
	end
	local humanoid = character:WaitForChild("Humanoid")
	humanoid.Died:Connect(function()
		-- Dying drops everything you were carrying into the crater.
		CarryService.dropAllCarried(player)
	end)
end

local function onPlayerAdded(player: Player)
	DataService.loadProfile(player)
	LeaderstatsService.createLeaderstats(player)
	local baseId = BaseService.assignBase(player)
	if not baseId then
		player:Kick("Starfall Rotlings is full! All 8 bases are taken. Try again soon.")
		return
	end
	local profile = DataService.getProfile(player)
	if profile then
		CarryService.restorePlaced(player, profile.placed)
	end
	player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(character)
		onCharacterAdded(player, character)
	end)
	if player.Character then
		onCharacterAdded(player, player.Character)
	end
	task.delay(2, function()
		IncomeService.broadcastHud()
	end)
end

local function onPlayerRemoving(player: Player)
	CarryService.dropAllCarried(player)
	DataService.saveProfile(player)
	BaseService.freeBase(player)
	DataService.dropProfile(player)
	State.carried[player.UserId] = nil
end

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(onPlayerAdded)
Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(onPlayerRemoving)
for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
	onPlayerAdded(player)
end

-- Save everyone when the server shuts down.
game:BindToClose(function()
	for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
		DataService.saveProfile(player)
	end
end)

print("Starfall Rotlings server ready.")
